protocol.heads: fit within-source contrast of both positives against five ordinary views; weight eight source means equally; compare last-layer-only to concatenated early, middle and final patches
protocol.input: bicubic square at 336 pixels, ImageNet normalization, deterministic single-thread CPU
protocol.selection: strictly above second-highest of twelve per-source control maxima
protocol.test: compare added useful feathered regions and additional ordinary flags versus regional format incumbent
